apps.name: CS Sign
apps.subtitle: Sign PDFs with your handwritten signature.
apps.localizedDescription:
Sign PDF documents with a hand-drawn signature, right on your iPhone or iPad.

• Import PDFs from Files, iCloud Drive or any app's share sheet, or scan paper documents with the camera
• Draw your signature with a finger or Apple Pencil, or import a photo or scan of it (the paper background is removed automatically)
• Place signatures, text, dates and checkmarks; drag to move, pinch to resize
• Save a signed copy with everything merged into the page, and share it
• Sync signatures between your devices through an iCloud Drive folder

No accounts, no subscriptions, no tracking. Your documents never leave your device.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Scan paper documents to sign them.
